_doc: Special teams (play/kicking.ts, play/returnSim.ts). meter: hold-to-fill power with a timing zone per kick. Phase 3b adds meter.aim, the second layer: after the power is locked a needle sweeps -1..1 (period s per side) and a tap locks it. Kickoff / field goal: aim = sideways direction (maxLateralDeg at the ends, green zone = zoneHalfWidth x kickWindow); punt: aim = launch angle (angleMin..angleMax), green around idealAngle. weight: share of the aim in the kick quality; residualLateral: share of the old random sideways error that remains. coverage: the user's cover man on his own kicks (DIVE tackle range/factor/lunge, a missed dive stumbles him, RIP cuts a return block short). Phase 3c: meter.penalty is one penalty curve shared by both layers: 0 inside the green zone, rising to 1 at badAt half-widths out (shape: exponent). The power layer's penalty costs up to distanceLoss of the launch speed; the aim layer's penalty costs up to aimDistanceLoss, flattens kickoffs / field goals by up to flatAngleDeg and pushes the kick up to extraLateralDeg further sideways (punts: the angle needle already flattens or balloons the kick). rules.kickoffOutOfBounds is the KICKING team's yard line where the receiving team takes over (40 = receiving frame 60).
